q: What comes next in the series: 2, 5, 8, 11, 14, ?

q: What comes next in the series: 5, 9, 13, 17, 21, ?
x: Each term adds 4: 21 + 4 = 25.

q: What comes next in the series: 3, 9, 15, 21, 27, ?
x: Each term adds 6: 27 + 6 = 33.

q: What comes next in the series: 1, 8, 15, 22, 29, ?
x: Each term adds 7: 29 + 7 = 36.

x: Each term adds 9: 40 + 9 = 49.

x: Each term subtracts 4: 34 - 4 = 30.

q: What comes next in the series: 30, 27, 24, 21, 18, ?

x: These are consecutive odd numbers, so the next is 9 + 2 = 11.

x: Each letter moves 2 places forward in the alphabet, so after G comes I.

q: What letter comes next: B, E, H, K, ?
x: Each letter moves 3 places forward in the alphabet, so after K comes N.

q: What letter comes next: Z, X, V, T, ?
x: Each letter moves 2 places back in the alphabet, so after T comes R.

q: What letter comes next: C, G, K, O, ?
x: Each letter moves 4 places forward in the alphabet, so after O comes S.

q: What letter comes next: T, Q, N, K, ?
x: Each letter moves 3 places back in the alphabet, so after K comes H.

q: What letter comes next: G, J, M, P, ?
x: Each letter moves 3 places forward in the alphabet, so after P comes S.

If 3 pens cost $6, how much do 5 pens cost at the same price?

q: A rope 20 feet long is cut into pieces 4 feet long. How many pieces are there?
x: 20 / 4 = 5 pieces.

q: How many even numbers are there from 1 to 20?
x: Every second number is even, so half of 20 gives 10.

q: Today is Wednesday. What day of the week will it be 4 days from now?
x: Count 4 days forward from Wednesday: Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

q: Today is Friday. What day of the week will it be 3 days from now?
x: Count 3 days forward from Friday: Saturday, Sunday, Monday.

q: Today is Sunday. What day of the week will it be 6 days from now?
x: Count 6 days forward from Sunday: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday.

q: Today is Thursday. What day was it 2 days ago?
x: Count 2 back from Thursday: that gives Tuesday.

q: Today is Tuesday. What day was it 3 days ago?
x: Count 3 back from Tuesday: that gives Saturday.

q: Today is Monday. What day was it 1 day ago?
x: Count 1 back from Monday: that gives Sunday.

q: How many days are there in 3 weeks?
x: A week has 7 days, and 3 x 7 = 21.

q: What month comes 4 months after October?
x: After October: November, December, January, February.

q: If the 5th of a month is a Tuesday, what weekday is the 13th?
x: 13 is 8 days after 5: one week plus 1 day, so Tuesday plus 1 is Wednesday.

q: A show starts at 3:15 and lasts 90 minutes. At what time does it end?
x: 90 minutes added to 3:15 gives 4:45.

q: A show starts at 4:30 and lasts 45 minutes. At what time does it end?
x: 45 minutes added to 4:30 gives 5:15.

q: A show starts at 7:20 and lasts 60 minutes. At what time does it end?
x: 60 minutes added to 7:20 gives 8:20.

q: A show starts at 1:45 and lasts 30 minutes. At what time does it end?
x: 30 minutes added to 1:45 gives 2:15.

q: A show starts at 10:10 and lasts 50 minutes. At what time does it end?
x: 50 minutes added to 10:10 gives 11:00.

q: How many hours pass between 9 AM and 5 PM on the same day?
x: From 9 to 12 is 3 hours and from 12 to 5 is 5 hours: 3 + 5 = 8.

q: How many minutes are there between 2:10 PM and 3:00 PM?
x: From 2:10 to 3:00 is 60 - 10 = 50 minutes.

q: What time is it 2 hours after 11 AM?
x: 11 AM plus 1 hour is noon, plus 1 more hour is 1 PM.

q: How many minutes are in 2 and a half hours?
x: 2 x 60 = 120, plus half an hour (30) = 150.

q: How many centimeters are in 3 meters?
x: 1 meter = 100 cm, so 3 x 100 = 300.

How many feet are in 4 yards?
x: 1 yard = 3 feet, so 4 x 3 = 12.

q: How many seconds are in 5 minutes?
How many grams are in 2 kilograms?
How many pints are in 3 quarts, if 1 quart is 2 pints?
How many legs do 3 dogs and 2 birds have altogether?
x: Dogs: 3 x 4 = 12. Birds: 2 x 2 = 4. Total 16.

q: How many sides do 2 triangles and 1 square have in total?
x: Triangles: 2 x 3 = 6. Square: 4. Total 10.

q: How many wheels are on 4 bicycles and 2 cars?
x: Bicycles: 4 x 2 = 8. Cars: 2 x 4 = 8. Total 16.

Ann is taller than Bo. Bo is taller than Cy. Who is the tallest?
x: Ann > Bo > Cy, so Ann is tallest.

q: Max is older than Lee. Kim is younger than Lee. Who is the youngest?
x: Max > Lee > Kim in age, so Kim is youngest.

q: Zed is faster than Jay. Lou is slower than Jay. Who is the slowest?
x: Zed > Jay > Lou in speed, so Lou is slowest.

q: Pat has more coins than Dan. Dan has more coins than Eve. Who has the fewest?
x: Pat > Dan > Eve, so Eve has the fewest.

q: Ann is heavier than Joe. Joe is heavier than Sue. Who is the lightest?
x: Ann > Joe > Sue, so Sue is lightest.

q: Joy finished before Ray. Ray finished before Sue. Who finished in the middle?
x: The order is Joy, Ray, Sue, so Ray is in the middle.

q: Which position is the odd one out: Apple, Carrot, Banana, Grape?
x: Apple, banana and grape are fruits; a carrot is a vegetable.

q: Which position is the odd one out: Sparrow, Dog, Cat, Horse?
x: Dog, cat and horse are mammals; a sparrow is a bird.

q: Which position is the odd one out: Red, Blue, Green, Square?
x: Red, blue and green are colors; a square is a shape.

q: Which one is the odd one out: 2, 4, 6, 9?
x: 2, 4 and 6 are even; 9 is odd.

q: Which one is the odd one out: 3, 5, 7, 9?
x: 3, 5 and 7 are prime numbers; 9 = 3 x 3 is not.

q: Which position is the odd one out: Car, Bus, Train, Chair?
x: Car, bus and train are vehicles; a chair is furniture.

q: Which position is the odd one out: Penny, Dime, Ruler, Nickel?
x: Penny, dime and nickel are coins; a ruler is not.

q: Which one is the odd one out: Eagle, Hawk, Owl, Bat?
x: Eagle, hawk and owl are birds; a bat is a mammal.

q: Which position is the odd one out: Bread, Water, Milk, Juice?
x: Water, milk and juice are drinks; bread is a solid food.

q: Which one is the odd one out: 16, 25, 36, 40?
x: 16, 25 and 36 are perfect squares (4x4, 5x5, 6x6); 40 is not.

q: Hot is to cold as up is to what?
x: Hot and cold are opposites, and the opposite of up is down.

q: Finger is to hand as toe is to what?
x: A finger is part of a hand; a toe is part of a foot.

q: Bird is to nest as bee is to what?
x: A bird lives in a nest; a bee lives in a hive.

q: Pen is to write as knife is to what?
x: A pen is used to write; a knife is used to cut.

q: Fish is to swim as bird is to what?
x: A fish moves by swimming; a bird moves by flying.

q: Eye is to see as ear is to what?
x: The eye is for seeing; the ear is for hearing.

q: Puppy is to dog as kitten is to what?
x: A puppy is a young dog; a kitten is a young cat.

q: Teacher is to school as doctor is to what?
x: A teacher works at a school; a doctor works at a hospital.

q: Slow is to fast as weak is to what?
x: Slow and fast are opposites, and so are weak and strong.

q: Glove is to hand as sock is to what?
x: A glove covers a hand; a sock covers a foot.

q: A farmer has 10 sheep. All but 3 run away. How many sheep are left?
x: "All but 3" means 3 stay. So 3 are left.

q: Ann's father has 5 daughters: Nana, Nene, Nini, Nono and a fifth. What is the fifth one's name?
x: Ann's father has five daughters, and Ann is one of them, so the fifth is Ann.

q: Which weighs more: a pound of feathers or a pound of bricks?
x: Both are one pound, so they weigh the same.

q: If a red house is made of red bricks, what is a greenhouse made of?
x: A greenhouse is a glass building for growing plants; it is not green-colored.

q: Tom is 8 and his sister is 4 years older. How old will she be when Tom is 12?
x: She is 4 years older now (12) and always will be, so when Tom is 12 she is 16.

q: How many letters are in the word that names the number after six?
x: The number after six is seven, which has 5 letters.

q: If you rearrange the letters of "TAC", which animal do you get?
x: T, A, C can be rearranged to C-A-T, which is a cat.

What is the first letter of the word that comes last in the alphabet: dog, cat, bird, fish?
x: In alphabetical order the last word is fish, and its first letter is F.

x: The largest is 0.75 and the smallest is 0.25. 0.75 + 0.25 = 1.

q: A square has a side of 5 cm. What is the distance around it?
x: A square has 4 equal sides: 4 x 5 = 20 cm.

x: At 6:00 the hour hand points at the 6.

q: How many months in a year have 30 days?
x: April, June, September and November have 30 days.

q: Counting by 5s from 5, what is the 8th number?
x: The nth number is 5 x n, so the 8th is 5 x 8 = 40.
